name: Rice blast
symptoms: diamond or spindle shaped spots with grey centre and brown edge on leaves, neck of the panicle turns black and breaks, humid cloudy weather
cause: Fungus that spreads in humid weather, especially with too much nitrogen
organic: Spray Pseudomonas fluorescens as advised; remove badly affected plants; avoid late and heavy nitrogen
chemical_note: If the attack is serious, ask your agriculture officer or KVK which approved product to use, and follow the label dose and safety period exactly.
prevention: Use resistant varieties and treated seed

name: Brown planthopper
symptoms: circular yellow then brown dried patches in the field hopper burn, small brown insects at the base of plants near water
cause: Sucking insect that multiplies with excess nitrogen and dense, continuously flooded fields
organic: Drain the field for a few days and use alternate wetting and drying; protect natural enemies such as spiders; do not spray randomly
chemical_note: If the attack is serious, ask your agriculture officer or KVK which approved product to use, and follow the label dose and safety period exactly.
prevention: Scout the base of the plants weekly

name: Rice stem borer
symptoms: dead hearts central shoot dries and pulls out easily in young plants, white empty panicles at flowering, small holes in stem
cause: Moth larvae that bore inside the stem
organic: Install pheromone traps; release Trichogramma egg parasitoid cards as advised; remove and destroy stubble after harvest
chemical_note: If the attack is serious, ask your agriculture officer or KVK which approved product to use, and follow the label dose and safety period exactly.

name: Bacterial leaf blight
symptoms: water soaked yellow stripes starting from leaf tips and edges that turn straw coloured and dry, after storms or flooding
cause: Bacteria that enter through wounds and spread through water
organic: Drain the field; avoid excess nitrogen; use clean irrigation water
chemical_note: There is no strong cure; ask your agriculture officer about recommended products for your area

name: Zinc deficiency (Khaira)
symptoms: rusty brown spots on middle leaves, stunted patches, pale new leaves in rice nursery or young crop
cause: Low zinc in the soil, common in alkaline or continuously flooded soils
organic: Apply well-decomposed farmyard manure or compost
chemical_note: Apply zinc sulphate only on the basis of a soil test or the local recommendation

name: Wheat yellow rust
symptoms: yellow stripes of powdery pustules along the leaves that rub off on fingers like turmeric, cool humid weather
cause: Fungus that spreads by wind in cool, humid weather
organic: Remove and destroy badly affected plants in small patches
chemical_note: If the attack is serious, ask your agriculture officer or KVK which approved product to use, and follow the label dose and safety period exactly.
prevention: Inspect leaves weekly in cool, cloudy weather

name: Fall armyworm
symptoms: ragged holes in leaves, sawdust like droppings in the whorl, young caterpillars feeding inside the whorl, damaged cobs
cause: Caterpillars of a moth that hide in the whorl
organic: Put sand or dry ash in the whorl; spray neem seed kernel extract 5% early; use pheromone traps to monitor; hand-pick egg masses and young larvae
chemical_note: If the attack is serious, ask your agriculture officer or KVK which approved product to use, and follow the label dose and safety period exactly.
prevention: Sow on time in the area
Inspect plants every 2-3 days in the first 8 weeks
Grow border crops as advised by experts

name: Pink bollworm
symptoms: rosette shaped flowers that do not open, damaged bolls, pink caterpillars inside seeds, stained lint
cause: Moth larvae that feed inside flowers and bolls
organic: Use pheromone traps for monitoring; collect and destroy damaged bolls; destroy crop residue after picking
chemical_note: If the attack is serious, ask your agriculture officer or KVK which approved product to use, and follow the label dose and safety period exactly.
prevention: Destroy stalks after the last picking
Do not store cotton stalks near the field

name: Whitefly
symptoms: tiny white insects flying up when leaves are shaken, sticky honeydew and black sooty mould, yellowing and curling leaves
cause: Sucking insect that also spreads leaf curl viruses
organic: Put up yellow sticky traps; spray neem oil 3-5 ml per litre of water with a little soap; remove weeds around the field
chemical_note: If the attack is serious, ask your agriculture officer or KVK which approved product to use, and follow the label dose and safety period exactly.
prevention: Avoid growing susceptible crops side by side

name: Aphids
symptoms: clusters of small green, black or yellow insects on tender shoots and under leaves, curling leaves, sticky honeydew, ants on plants
cause: Sucking insects that multiply quickly in dry or cloudy weather
organic: Spray a strong jet of water, then neem oil 3-5 ml per litre with a little soap; protect ladybird beetles
chemical_note: If the attack is serious, ask your agriculture officer or KVK which approved product to use, and follow the label dose and safety period exactly.

name: Early blight of tomato
symptoms: brown spots with concentric rings like a target on older lower leaves, leaves yellow and fall, spots on stems and fruit
cause: Fungus that survives in soil and crop residue
organic: Remove affected lower leaves; mulch to stop soil splash; rotate crops; use Trichoderma or Pseudomonas in the soil as advised
chemical_note: If the attack is serious, ask your agriculture officer or KVK which approved product to use, and follow the label dose and safety period exactly.

name: Late blight of tomato
symptoms: large dark water soaked patches on leaves and stems, white fuzzy growth under leaves in cool wet weather, firm brown patches on fruit
cause: Fast-spreading fungus-like organism in cool, wet, cloudy weather
organic: Remove and destroy affected plants quickly to stop spread
chemical_note: If the attack is serious, ask your agriculture officer or KVK which approved product to use, and follow the label dose and safety period exactly.
prevention: Scout daily in cool, wet weather

name: Tomato and chilli leaf curl virus
symptoms: leaves curl upward and become small, thick and crinkled, yellowing, stunted plants, few flowers, many whiteflies
cause: Virus spread by whiteflies
organic: Uproot and destroy infected plants early; control whitefly with yellow sticky traps and neem oil
chemical_note: There is no cure for the virus; control the whitefly and ask your agriculture officer about recommended products
prevention: Use healthy or protected nursery seedlings

name: Fruit borer (Helicoverpa)
symptoms: round holes in fruits, caterpillars inside fruits or bolls, droppings, fruits rot after damage
cause: Caterpillars of a moth that feed on flowers and fruits
organic: Install pheromone traps; plant marigold as a trap crop border; collect and destroy damaged fruits; use NPV if advised
chemical_note: If the attack is serious, ask your agriculture officer or KVK which approved product to use, and follow the label dose and safety period exactly.

name: Thrips and mites (leaf curl complex)
symptoms: leaves curl upward or become narrow and crinkled, silvery patches, tiny insects or mites on the underside, flowers drop
cause: Tiny sucking insects and mites that multiply in hot, dry weather
organic: Spray neem oil 3-5 ml per litre with a little soap; put up blue or yellow sticky traps; maintain soil moisture
chemical_note: If the attack is serious, ask your agriculture officer or KVK which approved product to use, and follow the label dose and safety period exactly.
prevention: Avoid broad-spectrum sprays that kill natural enemies

name: Groundnut leaf spot (tikka)
symptoms: brown to black circular spots with a yellow ring on leaves, leaves turn yellow and fall early, more in humid weather
cause: Fungus that survives on crop residue
organic: Use treated seed; remove crop residue; rotate crops; intercrop with a cereal as advised
chemical_note: If the attack is serious, ask your agriculture officer or KVK which approved product to use, and follow the label dose and safety period exactly.

name: Sugarcane red rot
symptoms: top leaves dry from the midrib, inside of the cane turns red with white cross bands, sour smell, cane splits
cause: Fungus carried by diseased setts and spread through water and soil
organic: Remove and burn or bury infected clumps; do not use them as setts
chemical_note: If the attack is serious, ask your agriculture officer or KVK which approved product to use, and follow the label dose and safety period exactly.
prevention: Use disease-free setts and resistant varieties

name: Sugarcane early shoot borer
symptoms: dead hearts in young shoots that pull out easily with a bad smell, small holes at the base of shoots, thin canes
cause: Moth larvae that bore into young shoots
organic: Earth up at the right time; remove and destroy dead hearts; pheromone traps for monitoring
chemical_note: If the attack is serious, ask your agriculture officer or KVK which approved product to use, and follow the label dose and safety period exactly.

name: Banana Panama wilt
symptoms: older leaves turn yellow from the edges and hang down like a skirt, splitting of the base of the pseudostem, brown streaks inside
cause: Soil-borne fungus that enters through roots
organic: Remove and destroy affected plants; apply Trichoderma in the soil as advised; improve drainage
chemical_note: There is no cure once the plant is affected; ask your agriculture officer about replanting advice
prevention: Do not move soil from infected fields

name: Banana bunchy top virus
symptoms: dwarf plants, short narrow leaves bunched at the top, dark green streaks on leaf veins and stalks, no proper bunch
cause: Virus spread by banana aphids and infected suckers
organic: Uproot and destroy infected plants immediately; control aphids with neem oil
chemical_note: There is no cure; remove infected plants and control the aphids
prevention: Never take suckers from infected plants

name: Nitrogen deficiency
symptoms: older leaves turn uniformly pale yellow starting from the tip, slow growth, thin stems, yellowing begins at the bottom of the plant
cause: Not enough nitrogen in the soil, or leaching after heavy rain
organic: Apply well-decomposed farmyard manure, compost or vermicompost; grow legumes in rotation
chemical_note: Apply fertiliser based on a soil test or the local recommendation, in split doses

name: Powdery mildew
symptoms: white powder like patches on upper leaf surfaces, leaves curl and dry, more in dry days with cool nights
cause: Fungus that likes dry weather with humid nights
organic: Spray diluted buttermilk or neem oil 3-5 ml per litre; remove badly affected leaves
chemical_note: If the attack is serious, ask your agriculture officer or KVK which approved product to use, and follow the label dose and safety period exactly.
prevention: Water at the base of plants

name: Finger millet (ragi) blast
symptoms: spindle shaped spots on leaves, neck turns black and breaks, fingers of the earhead dry and shrivel in humid weather
cause: Fungus that spreads in humid weather
organic: Use treated seed; remove badly affected plants; avoid excess nitrogen
chemical_note: If the attack is serious, ask your agriculture officer or KVK which approved product to use, and follow the label dose and safety period exactly.
